falkordb.name: falkordb
falkordb.threads_note: THREAD_COUNT and OMP_THREAD_COUNT are module load arguments that falkordblite does not expose

arcadedb.name: arcadedb
arcadedb.threads_note: configured to 1 thread: arcadedb.queryParallelismPoolThreads=1, arcadedb.parallelScanProducerPoolThreads=1, arcadedb.queryParallelScan=false, arcadedb.asyncWorkerThreads=1, java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.common.parallelism=1, GraphBatch parallel_flush=False; JVM: -XX:ParallelGCThreads=1, -XX:ConcGCThreads=1, -XX:CICompilerCount=2 (default collector and tiered compilation kept; 2 is HotSpot's minimum compiler count with tiered compilation, one C1 and one C2 thread); not capped: the JVM's other service threads (signal dispatcher, reference handler, finalizer) and ArcadeDB's housekeeping threads

neo4j.name: neo4j
neo4j.threads_note: configured to 1 thread: Cypher runs each query on the calling thread (Community has no parallel runtime); GDS concurrency=1 and readConcurrency=1; neo4j-admin import --threads=1; JVM (embedded and importer): -XX:ParallelGCThreads=1, -XX:ConcGCThreads=1, -XX:CICompilerCount=2; not capped: Neo4j's background threads (page cache flushing, checkpointing, index population) and the JVM's other service threads, which have no documented setting

oxigraph.name: oxigraph
oxigraph.threads_note: bulk_load uses several threads internally, not configurable; queries run on the calling thread
